recentDesc.zh: 在侧栏最上面列出最近 24 小时内有过动静的会话，最多十条；宿主的会话列表与置顶汇总不变。
recentDesc.en: Lists the conversations touched in the last 24 hours at the very top of the sidebar, ten at most; the host's own list and the pinned block stay as they are.

deleteNote.zh: 「{title}」的记录会从本机删除，无法恢复。
deleteNote.en: The stored record of “{title}” is removed from this device, and cannot be restored.

deleteOpen.zh: 会话还开着，先关掉它再删除。
deleteOpen.en: The conversation is still open; close it before deleting.
